snippet.title: Kitaria Fables 2 - World Premiere Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Cozy action RPG Kitaria Fables returns in this huge sequel! Join Alice Skylar and Dusty Tuftkin in the peaceful haven of Whitewall Town for an all new adventure! 

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
